What if you could see how a city policy plays out before anyone actually has to live with it? Two weeks ago at Hack the Valley, I teamed up with Steven Chow, Meet Patel, Aadit Gupta to build Two Worlds, an AI-powered simulation where you can test "what if" scenarios on a Toronto street and see how 100 AI residents react to the changes. Spent the weekend at SOON, hosted at a mansion surrounded by woods in Newmarket, and what an incredible experience! I spent most of day one bouncing between ideas and didn't settle on one until day two. What I ended up building was CrowdShip, a platform where users can playtest an app, suggest improvements, and vote on what should be built next.
